_source: What the CLI bundled with claude-agent-sdk 0.2.152 (claude-cli 2.1.259) SENT to a recording endpoint for one first message of a session, env as backend/llm.session_env sets it on an appliance — captured 11.11.2026, not written from the router's code. Changed by hand: device and session ids zeroed, the naming instructions cut after their first sentence. The request of the conversation itself (second call of the same capture) declared 28 tools and carried `thinking` and `context_management`; it is not kept here (80 kB).
